title: Bowser in the Dark World
coordinateSystem: Y up; source coordinates /100; yaw degrees from +Z toward +X; object transform Ry*Rx*Rz

motion.positionConvention: X = homeX + signedDistance*cos(moveYaw); Z = homeZ + signedDistance*sin(moveYaw)

routeActions: Press the purple switch near [-31, -29.46, 35.3]. Take the red coin on its timed block, then return immediately to the entrance ledge for the second timed-block red coin.
Return to the lower gap. Wait for the first square platform to begin returning toward the entrance side of its circuit, then run, crouch and jump across.
Follow the complete rising lower ramp loop. Board the live Ferris platform, ride it up, and jump onto the upper return ledge.
Climb the long trail past the red coin and cross the sliding platform when its X-axis motion closes the gap.
Wait for the upper square platforms to approach each other. Collect the red coin beside the first and cross all four moving platforms in sequence.
Follow the narrow side bridge to the octagonal red-coin perch, then return to the two seesaws.
Cross the lower seesaw and crouch-jump onto the higher one. Jump down to the narrow red-coin rail, then crouch-jump back.
Stand near the high seesaw’s far end to raise its opposite tip. Run back along the plank, pass beyond the overhead ledge, and jump from the rising tip onto the upper middle platform.
Jump left to the last red coin. Return to the middle platform, run and long-jump to the next upper ledge, then jump to the final ledge.
Press the final purple switch and jump up each raised pasta stair. Walk around the pipe and collect the star after its rising and bouncing spawn animation.

mission.name: Eight Red Coins
mission.sourceScope: Eight-red-coin secret star in the complete platform approach stage. Separate Bowser boss arena and key/Grand Star are outside this first-star mission.
